articles.summary: Publication marks the first time in nearly two decades that The New England Journal of Medicine has published clinical data on standalone real-time continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) technology, dating back to the creation of the CGM category. Randomized controlled trial demonstrates Dexcom G7 significantly reduces A1C and improves glucose control compared with routine care. Benefits observed across a broad range of participants, including those taking GLP-1 medications.1 Findings support the role of CGM earlier in Type 2 diabetes care for all people, including those over the age of 65. DexCom, Inc. (NASDAQ: DXCM), the global leader in glucose biosensing, today announced that results from the landmark CONNECT randomized controlled trial have been published in The New England Journal of Medicine (NEJM), providing rigorous evidence of the significant benefits of continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) for adults with Type 2 diabetes not on insulin. articles.summary: DexCom, Inc. (NASDAQ:DXCM) today announced that it plans to release its third quarter 2026 financial results after market close on Thursday, October 29, 2026. Management will hold a conference call to review the company's third quarter 2026 performance starting at 4:30 p.m. (Eastern Time) on the same day. The conference call will be concurrently webcast. The link to the webcast will be available on the Dexcom investor relations website at investors.dexcom.com and will be archived there for future reference. To listen to the conference call, please dial (888) 414-4585 (US/Canada) or (646) 960-0331 (International) and use the confirmation ID "9430114" approximately five minutes prior to the start time.
